text.aria-label: Subtitle text '6 solar farms and 3 wind farms; 53 forecast runs on Tuesdays, July 2025 to June 2026; pooled mixture of 51 ENS members, 3 seeds. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months. Green band: within 2.5 points of the 90% the band should cover. Cases with a 95% quantile below 1% of capacity (night-time solar) are left out.'
